SELECT sch.SCHEDULE_ID, sch.SCHEDULE_NAME, sch.SCHEDULE_CONTENT, sch.SCHEDULE_START_DT, sch.SCHEDULE_END_DT, sch.SCHEDULE_PLACE, sch.ALLDAY_WHETHER, sch.SCHEDULE_REGISTER_DT, sch.SCHEDULE_UPDATE_DT, emp.EMP_ID FROM CC_SCHEDULE sch JOIN SCHEDULE_EMPLOYEES emp ON sch.SCHEDULE_ID = emp.SCHEDULE_ID WHERE
(sch.SCHEDULE_GROUP_ID = #{schedule.scheduleGroupId} AND emp.EMP_ID = #{schedule.empId} AND #{schedule.scheduleDate} BETWEEN sch.SCHEDULE_START_DT AND sch.SCHEDULE_END_DT)
